# typed-config

> Typed configuration from environment, .env and JSON files into frozen dataclasses, with aggregated errors, masked secrets and generated docs Python package `trysac-typed-config`, import name `typed_config`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
